definitions.primary_scope: Each filter compared on its own known paired-evaluated candidate cohort.
definitions.common_scope: Every filter compared on the same all-filters-known paired-evaluated cohort.
definitions.feature_unknown: Unknown in the selected scope; this_filter_unknown separately counts that filter alone.
definitions.cash: Known excluded opportunities return exactly zero with no hypothetical trading costs.
definitions.costs: Already included in supplied net_return; no second fee deduction.
definitions.paired_delta: Kept net return or excluded cash zero, minus same-candidate baseline net return.
definitions.kept_only: Conditional descriptive distribution, never substituted for whole opportunity denominator.
definitions.rally: Gross endpoint return >=30% at20 sessions or >=50% at60; no5-session rally definition.
definitions.tail: Mean of worst ceil(0.05*n) per-event returns; not account maximum drawdown.
definitions.timing: Feature availability must be verified upstream at signal close; no future outcomes used to classify.
definitions.same_date: Equal-date mean of within-date kept-minus-excluded means; descriptive association only.

limitations: Historical periods were previously researched, not unseen validation.
Same-date controls do not remove stock selection confounding or demonstrate causality.
Date-cluster bootstrap retains repeated-stock and overlapping-holding dependence.
No multiple-testing correction, portfolio capacity or executable-fill validation.
An aggregate input schema cannot prove upstream booleans are free of look-ahead.

high400.name: 接近400日收盤高點
high400.definition: 今日還原收盤≥含今日400日最高還原收盤的99.8%；400個市場日完整有效。

course400.name: 400日價量高點完整條件
course400.definition: high400且今日量≥含今日10日最高量、含今日20日平均原始收盤×成交股數≥5億元。

rs20.name: 20日相對0050強勢
rs20.definition: 個股20日還原收盤報酬減0050同期報酬≥10個百分點；兩者21個市場日都有效。

smc_break5.name: 近5日出現SMC向上結構突破
smc_break5.definition: T-4至T至少一筆已確認smc_bull_break；64個連續有效市場日；只取訊號日，不讀事後區域狀態。

fvg_form5.name: 近5日形成多頭FVG
fvg_form5.definition: T-4至T至少一筆已確認fvg_form；64個連續有效市場日；區域之後失效不回刪形成訊號。

high400_and_rs20.name: 400日高點＋相對強勢
high400_and_rs20.definition: high400與rs20皆符合且兩者皆已知；任一資料不足都列未知。

high400_and_smc_break5.name: 400日高點＋近期SMC突破
high400_and_smc_break5.definition: high400與smc_break5皆符合且兩者皆已知；任一資料不足都列未知。

feature_definitions.purpose: filters on unchanged original-red known-first candidates; this module creates no entry dates
feature_definitions.signal_timing: all windows end at T close, no future outcome or lifecycle status is used
feature_definitions.price_basis: adjusted daily OHLC; turnover uses raw close times reported share volume
feature_definitions.missing: every market session retained; invalid, ineligible, nonfinite or nonpositive volume breaks the complete window
feature_definitions.recent_event_window: T-4..T inclusive; 64 complete valid sessions required
feature_definitions.conjunction: both inputs must be known, including when either condition is false
feature_definitions.benchmark: 0050 only for relative strength; missing benchmark leaves rs20 unknown
